criteria.requirement: Add Path.iter_lines(encoding=None,errors="strict",*,retain=True,newline=None), a lazy text iterator owning one context-managed stream. None uses universal newline normalization; "" retains original CR/LF/CRLF terminators; retain=False removes exactly the physical line ending. Preserve blank lines, Unicode, missing final newline and codec error policy. Early generator.close and decode/I/O exceptions must close the stream, with no whole-file read or changes to existing lines/read_text behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
